7.content: - Rate moves highest if they reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal (G) while staying on safe tiles (F); assign lower ratings to moves that increase distance or approach hazards (H). Prioritize landing adjacent to G on F tiles, enabling immediate goal reach.

10.content: - Prioritize moves that maintain a clear path to G without immediate hazards (H), rating them higher than moves that force detours around H or edges. In states where safe moves don't reduce distance to G, rate potentially risky moves higher if they enable progress toward G after a short detour.

11.content: - Boost ratings for moves that open up multiple future paths toward G, while penalizing moves that lead to narrow corridors or dead-ends flanked by H or edges.
